((OOC: Hey Storyteller, let's pause the roleplay for a quick memory update. Please summarize the most important recent events, focusing ONLY on the main plot, character statuses, and evolving relationships. 

IMPORTANT COMMAND: Do not write a traditional narrative summary. You must output the summary STRICTLY using the bracketed data structure provided below. Keep the entries concise, telegraphic, and objective. Avoid negative phrasing (e.g., use "confident" instead of "not shy"). 

Please fill out this exact template based on our recent interactions:

[CURRENT SETTING: {Insert physical location} - {Insert Time/Day}]
[PLOT PROGRESSION: {Bullet points of key factual events and discoveries}]
[ACTIVE CHARACTERS & ROLES: {Name}: {Current physical/mental status, and immediate objective}]
[RELATIONSHIPS & DYNAMICS: {Name & Name}: {Current state of their bond, tensions, or hierarchy shifts}]
[LINGUISTICS & LORE: {Any specific slang, accents, or cultural/world rules currently in play}]
[UNRESOLVED THREADS: {Pending actions, immediate next steps, or unanswered questions}]
))
